title: incident-bot: oncall runbook + automated diagnostics enhancements
author: Priya Desai
description: Adds several on-call helper features to incident-bot and SLO toolkit integrations: 1) automatic runbook linking in oncall alerts based on SLO tags and service mappings; 2) enriched diagnostic payloads with inference-related hints (model, quantization profile, pod metrics) to speed triage for ML-serving incidents; 3) caching layer for SLO lookups to reduce runtime latency and API cost; 4) opt-in rate limiting for runbook fetches to avoid spamming external systems during flapping incidents; and 5) a small public API change to expose recommended remediation steps for the UI. Motivation: recurring incidents during model rollout required faster context for oncall engineers and resulted in costly SLO lookups during peaks (ENG-5421). This PR wires incident-bot into the slo-toolkit utilities, adds integration tests, and includes migration notes for operators. Checklist: - [x] design doc referenced - [x] unit tests added - [x] e2e smoke test for runbook linking - [x] migration notes in README - [x] backwards compatible by default (feature gated)
commits: Summary: (1) feat(runbooks): add runbook linker and mapping table; (2) feat(diagnostics): include inference hints in diagnostic payload; (3) perf(slo-cache): add TTL cache + metrics; (4) docs: migration notes + runbook examples; (5) test: add unit and integration tests.
